_README: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored, so your numbers stay yours. If config.json is absent the tool falls back to this file, so a fresh copy runs with no setup at all.
_output_root: Where analyses are written. A relative path resolves against the package root (the folder holding README.md), never the current directory. Override per run with --root, or globally with the VIDEO_WATCHER_ROOT environment variable.
_font_path: Full path to a bold sans TTF used to burn timestamps into contact sheets. null = auto-detect (Arial Bold on Windows, DejaVu/Liberation on Linux, Arial Bold on macOS).

credits._README: Your generation provider's rates and your own per-video budget. These are PLACEHOLDERS - nothing here is a real quoted price. Rates move; look up your provider's live pricing and put it here. The analysis reads these from data/cost_config.json inside each run.
credits._rates: null = unknown. Any row priced against a null rate is reported as 'rate not configured' rather than guessed. coded_template is 0 by definition: code costs nothing to run.
credits._budget_per_video: Your ceiling for reproducing one video. null = no budget set, in which case totals are reported without a within/over verdict. Example: 150 / 250.

detection._README: Pacing tuning. Change these only with a reason - the defaults are the result of measurement, and METHOD.md sections 4-6 explain each one.

download._max_height: 720 is deliberate: 1280x720 frames sit under the vision model's long-edge ceiling, so on-screen text stays readable without paying for pixels that get downscaled away.
